# Apache ECharts 6.1.0

Unmodified browser distribution from the official Apache ECharts npm release:
https://registry.npmjs.org/echarts/-/echarts-6.1.0.tgz

The tarball was verified against the registry's SHA-512 integrity metadata before extracting only dist/echarts.min.js, LICENSE and NOTICE. Release provenance:
https://github.com/apache/echarts/releases/tag/6.1.0

The original license and attribution files are distributed next to the bundle. FinResearch uses this library to visualize saved financial records; it does not supply or validate research data. No runtime CDN access is required.
